title: Count of differing bytes whose trace depends on the length alone
contract_header:
use cd = "4nm36ybvfelwgkhw5up5nrtlzifjqmrgtkwzyype6baecjysqgda"  // ct_count_spec.ode

fn ct_count_diff(a: n bytes, b: n bytes, n: number)
    requires n < 4294967296
    returns cd.count_diff(a, b)
    trace depends on n
    stack 0
task_summary: Implement and verify `ct_count_diff`: it returns the number of places at which the two runs of `n` bytes differ, and its execution trace may depend on the length `n` alone (never on the bytes of `a` or `b`).
